title: Chat Basics
description: Start encrypted conversations with contacts using Nostr

steps.title: Open Chat View
steps.description: Click the chat icon in the sidebar or press Ctrl+Shift+C

steps.title: End-to-End Encryption
steps.description: All chats are encrypted using Nostr's NIP-44. Only you and the recipient can read messages.

steps.title: Add Contact
steps.description: Click 'New Chat' and enter the recipient's npub or hex public key

steps.title: Enter Public Key
steps.description: Paste the recipient's npub (starts with npub1...)

steps.title: Start Conversation
steps.description: Click 'Start Chat' to create the encrypted conversation

steps.title: Send Message
steps.description: Type a message and press Enter to send

action.value: Hello! This is my first encrypted message.
